milestone: M46 Headless Mode Pack Update Continuation

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets headless.continue_once perform one authorized, replay-safe Mode Pack candidate provenance verification step from an M46.1 selected-candidate fetch checkpoint.
Binds provenance verification to the registry-selected fetched candidate URL/content/policy/provenance/signer fingerprints already persisted by the Rust runtime.
Requires explicit headless continuation authorization and selected-candidate provenance verification authorization, and fails closed before provenance ledger mutation on stale or mismatched evidence.
Persists bounded continuation checkpoint evidence and replays without duplicating provenance verification ledger events or exposing raw provenance material.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development directly, with supporting progress for mode_pack_runtime, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can execute one selected-candidate provenance verification continuation from a prior selected-candidate fetch checkpoint and return bounded provenance result evidence plus explicit approval route.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: modepack.verifyCandidateProvenance verifies caller-supplied cached candidates, and M46.1 fetches the selected candidate, but no runtime-owned continuation binds the two with fresh progress, selected fetch checkpoint replay, and bounded next route.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Autonomous Mode Pack update loops would still need caller-owned glue between selected candidate fetch and provenance verification, outside Rust headless replay authority.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. R5.2 bound active candidate identity, M45.1 enforced registry trust before selection, and M46.1 fetched/cached the selected candidate; M46.2 executes the next distinct provenance verification step.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.continue_once request/response shape is extended and delegates to existing modepack.verifyCandidateProvenance behavior.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase uses bounded continuation checkpoint evidence and the existing ModePackVerifyCandidateProvenanceResult rather than adding report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, or verdict surfaces.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime validates fresh progress, explicit verification authorization, M46.1 fetch checkpoint, selected registry evidence, active snapshot identity, candidate/provenance/signer fingerprints, then performs one provenance verification side effect and replays without duplicate verification evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A scheduled headless caller can move from cached selected candidate to verified provenance with deterministic replay and next_action for explicit approval.
answers.milestone_progress: Moves M46 from selected-candidate acquisition to selected-candidate trust verification; explicit approval and active replacement remain later continuations.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M46.2 updates the deterministic current phase manifest and archives the M46.2 value gate. Review must confirm this is headless selected-candidate provenance verification execution, not a report/readiness wrapper.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts one bounded modepack_selected_candidate_provenance_verification_target with explicit authorization and fresh progress evidence

runtime revalidates M46.1 fetch continuation id, fetch decision id, selection id/event id, candidate URL/content/policy fingerprints, provenance statement URL/hash, signer fingerprint, and active activation fingerprint before verification mutation

successful continuation delegates to the existing Mode Pack candidate provenance verification path and returns bounded ModePackVerifyCandidateProvenanceResult with next_action approve_verified_modepack_candidate_explicitly
same continuation_id replays persisted bounded evidence without duplicating provenance verification ledger events

stale progress, missing authorization, malformed fingerprints/base64, missing or mismatched fetch checkpoint, mismatched selection evidence, changed active snapshot, statement hash mismatch, or signer mismatch deny before side effects

VSIX protocol validation accepts only bounded target/result fields and rejects raw candidate, registry, provenance, signature, public-key, IP, prompt, command, environment, file, path, credential, or secret fields
no new RPC, report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, generic network executor, automatic approval, or automatic activation is added
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test headless_continue_once_fetches_registry_selected_candidate_and_replays now proves selected fetch checkpoint can continue into one provenance verification result and replay without duplicate candidate fetch or provenance verification ledger events.
VSIX runtimeClient test validates bounded modepack_selected_candidate_provenance_verification_target and modepack_verify_candidate_provenance_result fields while rejecting raw provenance fields.
Existing modepack.verifyCandidateProvenance tests remain the delegated signature/statement/cached candidate verification foundation.
